detail.longDescription: Confession time: I'm a chronic email avoider. If you've emailed me in the past few months, rest assured that I still haven't opened it. At some point, I realized I'd rather get slowly buried under an avalanche of Kohl's marketing emails and Amazon delivery updates than deal with my inbox like an adult.
